newsitem.title: USA: Societe Generale hires Kyle in cap markets.
newsitem.headline: Societe Generale hires Kyle in cap markets.

text.p: Societe Generale's Societe Generale Securities Corp said Monday it hired Donald Kyle, formerly of Union Bank of Switzerland's UBS Securities LLC, as managing director of its capital markets group.

"This is an important step in our ongoing effort to build our New York-based primary market origination and execution capabilities," said John Kelly, the head of the Societe's capital markets group, in a statement.
Societe Generale Securities is a subsidiary of Societe Generale USA, the U.S. arm of French bank Societe Generale.
